meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键发布 npm 包到生产环境
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护 npm 包并需要自动化发布流程
copy.tagline_en: Publish npm packages to production with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain npm packages and need automated release

howto.what: Claude 会执行完整的发布工作流：确认版本类型（patch/minor/major）、检查代码同步、触发 GitHub Actions 发布任务、等待完成、生成发布说明、更新 GitHub 发布页、发 Discord 公告，并验证 npm 包和 Codex 插件均发布成功。
howto.when: 当你使用“发布”“release”“deploy”“npm publish”等关键词，并要求发布 oh-my-opencode 到 npm 时触发。需要你同时指定版本类型。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
帮我发布 minor 版本到 npm
say.note: Claude 会询问确认后执行完整发布。

say.text: 发布 major 版本并通知 Discord
say.note: Claude 会包括 Discord 公告步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude executes the full publish workflow: confirm bump type, sync code, trigger GitHub Actions, wait for completion, draft release notes, update GitHub release, post to Discord, and verify npm packages and Codex plugin are published.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'publish', 'release', 'deploy', or 'npm publish' for oh-my-opencode, and you must also specify a version bump type (patch/minor/major).

say_en.note: Claude will start the minor or patch release process immediately.

say_en.text: Help me publish a minor version to npm
say_en.note: Claude will ask for confirmation then run the full workflow.

say_en.text: Publish a major version and notify Discord
say_en.note: Claude will include the Discord announcement step.
